clue.text: Not a natural key for this accommodation

clue.text: Clot mishandled a weapon

clue.text: Carried out some shock manoeuvres in the field

clue.text: Rectitude of converted screen set

clue.text: A line drawn where it's hard to get figures to balance

clue.text: Dress with royal honour

clue.text: You may get into a row if you sit down here

clue.text: Answer back if you wish; I'm switching round your vote

clue.text: Treading down wild grim plant

clue.text: Look out, sir! He might club the missus!.

clue.text: Carrots for Brezhnev?
